reviews.author: Judi Whittington
reviews.text: Working with Roger and his company Southeast Tree & Stump Removal Service was an amazing experience. The teams skill at working the chainsaw from within the bucket lift had the entire neighborhood watching from their porches. The team under Rogers direction was able to remove four 80 ft dead trees. One of the trees needed to be pulled the opposite direction from where it was leaning over power lines and a house. As a team they all communicated and worked together with hand gestures and nods to drop the tree in a narrow path with required precision. All bystanders held their breath while the team worked their magic with precise target perfection. I highly recommend Southeast Tree & Stump Removal Service for everyone needing tree and stump services.

reviews.author: Patricia Shankle
reviews.text: Great work by great folk. Prompt, good communication, fast, efficient and excellence. We are pleased with the way our backyard looks after they removed trees and tackled a huge job of clearing the property. If you want it done right, call Roger & Amy. They are the best.

reviews.author: Annette Reed
reviews.text: Was extremely please. Arrived on time, did an excellent job of removing a fallen tree as well as cutting down a tree that was in danger of coming down. Were very meticulous in making sure that wood was removed and area was cleaned of any debris. Will use again if the need arises. Picture prior to removing.

reviews.author: D. Moore
reviews.text: I called South East Tree Removal needing a tree cut urgently. Mr. Deberry came out the very next day and gave a very reasonable estimate. He came out the following morning to do the job and I was extremely impressed with how him and his guys treated the property. They were very considerate with their big trucks not to cause damage to the yard and they cleaned up everything before they left, leaving the yard better than it was when they came. The tree he cut was very big and in a tight space. I would definitely recommend South East Tree Removal to anyone needed this type of service.

reviews.author: Patti Priest
reviews.text: Southeast Tree and Stump Removal cut down five trees on my property. Two of the trees were mature pine trees approximately 60-70 feet tall located between my house and a power line. I had reached out to several tree services before I found Southeast. Some of the services didn’t show up to look at the trees and those that did, didn’t want to touch them. I was very concerned about the proximity of the trees to my house. Southeast took down the trees safely and ground all the stumps. My yard looks great! I no longer worry about a tree falling on my house during a storm. Definitely reach out if you need trees removed. I know Southeast will be getting all my tree removal business.

reviews.author: Nichole Bruce
reviews.text: I highly recommend Southeast Tree & Stump Removal for any of your tree related needs. They are knowledgeable, professional and very financially fair with their prices for services. I was amazed with their communication and how quick they were able to get to us and got our very dead trees down and out. Roger, the owner, will make sure things are done right and takes great pride in his company. We will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Patti Parker
reviews.text: My husband, and I highly recommend Mr. Deberry. He was very professional. He removed two huge trees along with several other trees, and the stumps at a great price. We will use him again.

reviews.author: Jackie ussery
reviews.text: Very timely, professional and courteous. We could not have asked anyone more capable of helping us clear our yard debris
